scope: Native Studio responsiveness with a selected recording, imported GLB, clean output and two numeric debug windows.
input_method: 80 background-timestamped synthetic Tk drag positions per phase, dispatched on the actual UI thread; not physical pointer or sensor latency.

pixel_equivalence.input_class: Authored observations and the supplied GLB; no source pixels.

implementation: One bounded graphics owner serializes renderer mutations, avatar drawing and numeric diagnostics.
Tk installs completed images and services controls independently.
Seek/source epochs reject late results; displayed-frame expiry remains independent of graphics completion.
Raw input stays on its separate opt-in path, outside the avatar renderer.
Numeric dominant-role lookup and read-only per-asset masks replace repeated string membership searches.
retained_failed_attempts: Cooperative view scheduling alone exceeded the declared latency budget.
Avatar-only background drawing still exceeded the budget with numeric debug views open.
A native import helper originally waited for model commit rather than the first rendered frame; it now awaits that specific result.
One concurrent book/full-suite run exceeded the existing two-second early-stop test budget. The isolated case and serial full suite passed unchanged; production deadlines were not weakened.
